verdict.rationale: Gusto Embedded documents registrable outbound webhooks. Developers create a subscription for chosen subscription_types, verify it with a verification_token, and receive HMAC-signed event payloads. A health-check endpoint covers the webhooks system, and a documented payroll.paid event fires when payroll is paid out, so downstream automation on payroll lifecycle is clearly supported. missing for 10: evidence of employee-onboarded and payment-failed event types, a fuller event catalog, retry/delivery semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
